chat.text:
> Redundant title on chit-chat cards in Chat v3

You're right, it's redundant. I haven't written a title or refined text for your last two prompts. The page makes a card for every prompt and fills in the title itself, so "Hello" shows up twice.

My recommendation:

- **Short or chit-chat prompts:** no title and no refined paragraph. Your words show as a plain bubble, and my reply nests under it.
- **Real topics:** keep the card with a title and the ranked outcomes. I would only write a title when the refined version adds something beyond your own words.
- **Rendering rule:** if a card's title matches its text, or the prompt is under about a sentence or two, hide the title line. This is the more reliable fix, because it holds even when the page auto-fills a title.

The rendering rule is a change to the Chat v3 page. Want me to have a mastermind make it?

> Replaying a chat bubble

Today you can't replay a finished bubble. Replay is planned but not built yet.

- **What a tap does now:** tapping a bubble only plays or pauses what is being read right now. After a reply finishes, there is nothing to resume.
- **Planned replay:** tapping an old bubble will replay it from its last spoken word, regenerating the audio each time by default. A `replay_audio` setting (regenerate or keep) will control that.
- **Also planned:** a per-bubble toolbar with play/pause and back 10 seconds.

The audio Recite page documents this (see its "still to come" list). I can have a mastermind build tap-to-replay if you want it.
